text: Over the past 30 days, some visitors noted overcrowding issues, particularly when large school groups arrived simultaneously, which limited access to certain exhibits. A few reviews expressed disappointment with the depth of historical content, feeling the presentations relied too much on technology without providing enough detailed context about Theodore Roosevelt’s presidency. There were also concerns raised about the use of generative AI in exhibits, with some visitors feeling it conflicted with Roosevelt’s legacy. Positive comments frequently mentioned the interactive exhibits and the building’s architecture, but a small number of visitors suggested improvements in interpretation and historical balance. Staff interactions received generally favorable mentions.
